business_problem: Riding the wave of disruptive technologies "Generative AI represents a real technological breakthrough that we need to seize," asserts Nicolas Thibaut, pointing out that within Cdiscount, the potential of this technology is unanimously supported, first and foremost, by management.
solution_summary: Cdiscount used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, GitHub Copilot to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as GitHub Copilot, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: GitHub Copilot
solution_components.role: Accelerates software development by assisting engineers with code generation and editing.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
